scientific_integrity: The original curve and its special tangent-contact orders are known. The contribution is the dual-branch value semigroup, conductor, and delta invariant. Uniform proof is symbolic; finite tests are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Only three specified dual germs are classified; no completeness claim for all singularities or bitangents of the dual. The theorem excludes characteristic two. Exact originality relative to all historical literature is not externally certified.
title: Three distinguished wild cusps on the duals of odd-characteristic Pellikaan curves
